## Overview

Built **real-time anomaly dashboards** using the **Elastic Stack** (Elasticsearch + Kibana) to surface fraudulent transactions and internal threat indicators across geospatial and high-velocity transactional pipelines.

## Architecture

- **Ingestion:** Structured logs and transaction events indexed into Elasticsearch
- **Detection:** Rule-based and statistical anomaly queries (e.g., velocity spikes, geo-impossible travel)
- **Visualization:** Kibana dashboards with drill-down filters for fraud analysts and security operations

## Outcomes

- Reduced mean time to detect suspicious patterns across regional transaction clusters
- Unified view for fraud and insider-threat monitoring stakeholders
- Repeatable dashboard templates for new data sources
